title: O Christmas Tree: Why Pine Trees Stay Green in Winter Snow!

lines.text: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree, how lovely are your branches!
lines.caps: O Christmas *TREE, | O Christmas tree, how *LOVELY | are your *BRANCHES!

lines.text: While oak and maple trees drop all their leaves, pine trees stay brilliantly green!
lines.caps: While oak and maple trees *DROP | all their leaves, pine trees stay *BRILLIANTLY | *GREEN!

lines.text: Why don't evergreen trees freeze and lose their needles in the snow?
lines.caps: Why don't evergreen trees *FREEZE | and lose their needles in the *SNOW?

lines.text: Pine needles are super skinny, so heavy snow slides right off without snapping branches!
lines.caps: Pine needles are super *SKINNY, | so heavy snow slides right *OFF | without snapping *BRANCHES!

lines.text: Each needle is coated in a thick, waterproof wax called cuticle that locks in water!
lines.caps: Each needle is coated in a *THICK, | waterproof wax called *CUTICLE | that locks in *WATER!

lines.text: Inside their cells, evergreen trees produce natural sugar antifreeze!
lines.caps: Inside their *CELLS, | evergreen trees produce natural *SUGAR | *ANTIFREEZE!

lines.text: This stops winter ice crystals from puncturing delicate plant cells!
lines.caps: This stops winter ice *CRYSTALS | from puncturing delicate plant *CELLS!

lines.text: Now you know the botanical secret behind O Christmas Tree!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the botanical *SECRET | behind O Christmas *TREE!
